name: scopes
title: Session scopes
summary: | Scope | Allows | |---|---| | read | Read documents, schemas, history, logs and docs. | | edit:scene | Edit scenes and prefabs through commands. | | edit:assets | Edit other authored assets (materials, UI, settings). | | edit:code | Edit game and editor code. | | play | Start, step and control play worlds. | | run | Run scripts against the typed SDK (code mode). | | import | Import source media. | | bake | Bake derived data (lighting, navigation). | | build | Build and export the game. | | generate:$ | Run generation jobs that spend money. | | fs:outside-project | Read or write files outside the project. | | net | Use the network. |
html:
ScopeAllows
readRead documents, schemas, history, logs and docs.
edit:sceneEdit scenes and prefabs through commands.
edit:assetsEdit other authored assets (materials, UI, settings).
edit:codeEdit game and editor code.
playStart, step and control play worlds.
runRun scripts against the typed SDK (code mode).
importImport source media.
bakeBake derived data (lighting, navigation).
buildBuild and export the game.
generate:$Run generation jobs that spend money.
fs:outside-projectRead or write files outside the project.
netUse the network.

The default policy grants agents every scope except generate:$, fs:outside-project and net.
